name: vibestack

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @repo/design-system build && node vibestack/spec.ts gen vibestack/studio && node -e "fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "fs.chmodSync('dist/spec.js', 0o755); fs.mkdirSync('dist/proof', { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync('vibestack/proof/lib.dfy', 'dist/proof/lib.dfy'); fs.cpSync('vibestack/studio/src/public', 'dist/studio/src/public', { recursive: true }); fs.cpSync('vibestack/std', 'dist/std', { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync('vibestack/conformance.ts', 'dist/conformance.ts')"

description: Stories, rules and Quint in a Markdown spec tree; verified TypeScript out.
